stem: Which classification best describes an infantile haemangioma?
explanation: Superficial, deep, or mixed is the correct classification of infantile haemangioma.

citations.source: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf
citations.title: Page 86

optionExplanations.A: Incorrect because these are general lesion morphology terms, not the haemangioma classification used here.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because this is a malignancy classification, not the classification of infantile haemangioma.
optionExplanations.C: Correct because infantile haemangiomas are classified as superficial, deep, or mixed.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because capillary, venous, and lymphatic are vascular anomaly terms, not the classification given for infantile haemangioma.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because these are not the categories used to classify infantile haemangioma.
